law_name: Organic Law on Personal Data Protection (LOPDP)
key_requirements: Lawful basis & consent, data subject rights, security & breach notification
data_categories: Personal data; sensitive data; health data; children's data
retention_period: As long as necessary for the purpose
enforcement_authority: Superintendency of Personal Data Protection (Superintendencia de Protección de Datos Personales)
penalties_range: Up to 1% of prior-year annual turnover (private sector)
notes: In force 2021-05-26; sanctions regime from 2023-05-26; Regulation Decree 904 (Nov 2023)
